evidence: Walked every scored and gate criterion against the frozen golden. No criterion was found that the reference cannot satisfy. Gates: render passes because a wrong password gets 401 from POST /api/auth/login (index.js:84-87) and the login-error is shown (app.js:206); a correct sign-in renders Board, Conversations and Activity. Constraints/global gate: a recruiter opens a job and adds a card through the board.js forms (lines 40-82), the rows persist in SQLite, and the observer's /api/bootstrap lists all jobs and applications (index.js:178-191). FUNCTIONAL. hro_job_open: title/team text() required, manager must have role hiring_manager, interview_limit must satisfy Number.isInteger and 1..50 (index.js:204-207); the client sends NaN to null for '2.5' (board.js:72); team appears in the job selector ('title · team', board.js:353), manager in the facts line (board.js:366), places in the 'Interview (n of N places)' heading (board.js:327). hro_add_candidate: bottom of Applied (index.js:229), email on card meta (board.js:251). hro_add_email_rules: regex and lowercase duplicate check return {field:'candidate_email'} (index.js:221-224); the fault shows at the email field and the name is not cleared on failure (board.js:52-56); scripted run asserted aria-invalid and name kept (workspace.cjs:256-260); the same email on another job is accepted because uniqueness is (job_id,candidate_email). hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_reopen: checkMove FLOW +/-1, HIRED reject refused, reopen only to rejected_from (index.js:247-256); the UI offers only legal targets (board.js:144-158); undo restores rejected_from/reject_reason from before_json (index.js:302-303,365). hro_arrive_bottom: no before_id puts the card at columns[toStage].length (index.js:306). hro_reorder / hro_interview_reorder_free: Up/Down send a same-stage move with before_id (board.js:233-241); entering counts only non-Interview cards (index.js:290). hro_interview_full/hro_bulk_places/hro_undo_full: whole-set capacity check (index.js:291-295) and undo capacity check (index.js:357-359). hro_refused_put_back: snapshot restore, alert text and focus back on the card's select/name (board.js:191-198); scripted group 'full Interview put back with the reason and focus on the card' passed. hro_mgr_*: manager limited to own job and INTERVIEW/OFFER/HIRED origin/target incl. reject/reopen (index.js:257-264); job/candidate creation is auth('recruiter'). hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_anonymous: mayMove 403/404, auth() 401 before any read (index.js:73-81,326-333,376-386). hro_stale_refused: version mismatch gives 409 with '<name> was changed by someone else (Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied)' from the latest activity line (index.js:241-245). hro_bulk_move: server and client sort by stage index then position (index.js:284-288, board.js:286), so Y,W,X and A2,V hold. hro_bulk_all_or_none: all checks run before any write inside one immediate transaction (index.js:274-320). hro_undo_restores/hro_undo_conflict/hro_undo_once: before index re-insertion yields Y,W,X,Z,A2; any version change refuses; the latest own action only, single-use, and notes do not bump the version (index.js:348-373,380-386). Hand-tracing protocol B steps 1-14 against this logic gives the expected outcome at every step, including W's reorder by Mei bumping W's version in step 14. hro_activity/hro_activity_refusals: one line per card for open/add/move/reject (with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo, all inside the rolled-back transaction (index.js:195-198,211,230,311-317,366); the job filter is in app.js:65. hro_notes: own-manager rule (index.js:382), observer reads via the STAFF detail route. hro_live_board/hro_msg_exchange/hro_seen/hro_unread_counts: every successful non-GET broadcasts an SSE 'changed' (index.js:48-53), the client refreshes and catchUp() fetches after= with seen_up_to (threads.js:145-159). The seen boundary excludes the observer (index.js:143-150). Unread excludes own messages and sending marks read (index.js:133,413). The seed gives Lena 1 unread (APP-301 read_count 2 of 3, third message from Farah). hro_thread_latest/earlier: PAGE=30 newest, earlier_count, 'Show earlier messages (N more)' (index.js:397-404, threads.js:85-87,160-175). hro_unread_scrolled_up: stay=false increments pending and shows the '1 new message' pill without marking read (threads.js:152-158,176-181); the scripted group passed. hro_msg_compose: Enter/Shift+Enter handler, blank refused, box cleared and refocused (threads.js:183-201), .message .body white-space:pre-wrap (styles.css:105). hro_drafts: localStorage per user id and conversation (app.js:39-43, threads.js:112,124,182). hro_thread_access: thread access by role (index.js:114-120), the observer gets readOnly with no composer (threads.js:140-142). hro_candidate_view/private/linked: candidate read model has only title, team, label and thread summary (index.js:171-176); card detail is STAFF-only; another application gives 404; SSE payload is 'data: 1'; the account email link is made at insert (index.js:225). hro_restart: seedIfEmpty skips when users exist (db.js:61-62); seed order Greta, Ade, Marco / Priya, Samuel and Noor's note match the criterion text. POLISH: live_board keeps keyed nodes and the detail textarea untouched (board.js:321-341); live_thread appends only (threads.js:91-99); earlier_place does scrollTop=top+delta in the .messages scroll container (threads.js:167-171, styles.css:101); failed_send turns a fetch rejection into status 0 with 'Not sent...' and keeps the text (app.js:31, threads.js:194); the note draft is kept in localStorage (board.js:98,120); session_resume runs 401 to sessionLost() into the login prompt, keeps drafts keyed by user id, and Mei's key differs (app.js:34,189-195). VISUAL: a coherent token-based stylesheet; board.png shows a clean aligned 6-column board. Runtime support: the raw-evidence-index hashes all verify and match the frozen source bytes. The scripted golden run (workspace.json) has 22 groups passed with page_errors [], covering most legs. Counterexample attempts: (a) A dead or partial app cannot earn this row's oracle claim. That is out of scope for row 18. (b) I looked for conforming-golden false fails. 1. In the Activity view, app.js:46,79-80 shows 50 lines, then 'Show more (N earlier)'. J1+J2 in this review will exceed 50 lines, so a judge that does not click Show more could wrongly mark hro_activity. 2. hro_seen: if the judge leaves Tomas's independent page open on the conversation, the golden correctly auto-marks the new message read, and 'Seen' appears before Aud/Tomas 'opens' it. A literal judge could call that 'too early'. 3. hro_unread_counts: with the conversation open at its newest, the badge briefly shows 1 after the refresh until catchUp/markRead clears it. Only a snapshot taken before 15 s would see it. All three are judge-behaviour risks, not golden defects.
run_verdict_detail: Scripted golden observations (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json, hashes verified) CONFIRM most legs. Not exercised by any run: UI refusal of job places 0/51/2.5 and a blank title; the aborted-send leg of hro_pol_failed_send; full Activity completeness, ordering and filter for an A-protocol-sized history; and visual Likert craft. No full configured judge run, Oracle grade or judge-duration measurement exists (the raw-evidence-index scope says so explicitly). That leaves 'the oracle can score high' unmeasured.
risk_reason: risk=true because the required runtime evidence is missing: there is no configured functional/polish/visual judge run on the golden and no Oracle score. The 41-criterion functional protocol's real completion within the judge budget is unmeasured, which affects whether the oracle actually scores high. The three judge-behaviour hazards listed in the evidence (Activity pagination at 50, hro_seen with Tomas's page left open, the transient unread badge) are unresolved by measurement. No golden defect found.
